login.title: Healthier days, together.
login.subtitle: Track your pets' health and keep every document in one place.
login.privacyNote: We only access the files the app creates in your Drive.

google.privacyNote: PetHealth only accesses the files it creates in your Drive — never the rest of your documents.

delete.title: Delete my account
delete.description: Deletion permanently erases your pets and their health records from PetHealth. Files already saved in your Google Drive stay there — you can remove them from Drive yourself. This can't be undone.

modal.title: Delete your account?
modal.description: Your pets and their health records will be permanently deleted from PetHealth. Your scans stay in your Google Drive.
modal.error: The account could not be deleted. Please try again.
